statement.text:
Let M be a free metabelian group of finite rank r ⩾ 2, and let P be the set of
its primitive elements. (An element of a relatively free group is said to be primitive
if it can be included in a basis of the group.)
     a) Is P a first-order definable set?
     b) Is the set of bases of the group M a first-order definable set?
                                                                              E. I. Timoshenko
